findings.title: CSP 未允许 Sentry 错误追踪
findings.description: Content-Security-Policy 中未包含 sentry.io，可能导致 Sentry 错误追踪 被拦截
findings.location: CSP: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://www.googletagmanager.com https://www.google-analytics.com https://emrldtp.com https://giscus.app; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https:/...
findings.recommendation: 在 CSP 的 connect-src 和/或 script-src 中添加 sentry.io
